title: Direct Inference on Admissible Sets (Diona)
abstract: arXiv:2610.31526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a new regression method named Direct Inference on Admissible Sets (Diona) that directly uses samples to estimate the state and its derivatives at a query point, along with their admissible bounds, without long global training. By casting the values and derivatives at the query and neighbouring samples as latent variables in a constrained optimisation problem, the burden of long training loops becomes one of on-demand local solves. We establish Diona's theoretical properties including finite-sample coverage and, in the noiseless case, convergence to the true state and derivatives under dense sampling. In a nonlinear regression benchmark on six functions of three to eight dimensions, Diona was more accurate than a Gaussian process (GP) on noiseless data especially with denser data sets. Furthermore, as with GP, it produced uncertainty bounds that contained the true value at more than 95% of query points in four functions. Dion

translated_title: 可容许集上的直接推断
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种名为“可容许集上的直接推断”的新回归方法，该方法直接利用样本估计查询点处的状态及其导数，以及它们的可容许界，而无需漫长的全局训练。通过将查询点及邻近样本处的值和导数视为约束优化问题中的潜在变量，长时间训练循环的负担转变为按需的局部求解。我们建立了Diona的理论性质，包括有限样本覆盖率，以及在无噪声情况下、稠密采样条件下收敛到真实状态和导数的性质。在一个包含六个三至八维函数的非线性回归基准测试中，Diona在无噪声数据上比高斯过程（GP）更准确，尤其是在数据集更稠密的情况下。此外，与GP类似，它在四个函数中产生的界在超过95%的查询点处包含了真实值。
tldr: Diona是一种无需全局训练、通过按需局部求解约束优化问题直接从样本估计查询点状态及导数的新回归方法，在无噪声数据上精度超越高斯过程，且具备有限样本覆盖等理论保证。
en_tdlr: Diona is a new regression method that directly estimates states and derivatives at query points from samples via on-demand local solves of a constrained optimization problem, without global training, achieving higher accuracy than Gaussian processes on noiseless data with finite-sample coverage guarantees.
